mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens + completion_tokens), 0) FROM ai_usage WHERE create_time >= #{since}

SELECT feature AS `key`, NULL AS name, COUNT(*) AS calls, COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens), 0) AS promptTokens, COALESCE(SUM(completion_tokens), 0) AS completionTokens FROM ai_usage WHERE create_time >= #{since} GROUP BY feature ORDER BY feature

SELECT CAST(t.user_id AS CHAR) AS `key`, COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username) AS name, t.calls, t.promptTokens, t.completionTokens FROM ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS calls, COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens), 0) AS promptTokens, COALESCE(SUM(completion_tokens), 0) AS completionTokens FROM ai_usage WHERE create_time >= #{since} AND user_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY user_id ) t LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.user_id ORDER BY t.promptTokens + t.completionTokens DESC LIMIT #{limit}
